constructions.meaning_en: to have or maintain the view that something is true

constructions.definition_en: used to ask someone to wait for a short time

constructions.learning_note: I could not get hold of her.＝我联系不上她。

constructions.definition_en: to find or obtain something needed

constructions.meaning_cn: （通话中）等候；让来电者等候而不挂断

constructions.meaning_cn: 抑制情绪流露；忍住眼泪
constructions.definition_en: to suppress the expression of emotion
constructions.learning_note: He held back his tears.＝他忍住了眼泪。

constructions.usage_note: 不带宾语；from 后用 doing。

constructions.usage_note: 交通、行程和工作进度均可；hold me up。

constructions.meaning_cn: 在压力下撑住；保持有效

constructions.boundary: 不带宾语；She is holding up well.

constructions.definition_en: for supplies or money to last
constructions.learning_note: Our supplies held out.＝我们的物资一直够用。

constructions.definition_en: to continue resisting or enduring difficulty
constructions.learning_note: They held out for days.＝他们坚持抵抗了好几天。

constructions.definition_en: to extend an arm or offer an object by holding it forward
constructions.learning_note: She held out her hand.＝她伸出了手。

constructions.definition_en: to offer hope or a possibility
constructions.learning_note: The plan holds out hope of recovery.＝这个计划带来了复苏的希望。

constructions.meaning_cn: 认为某人应为某事负责
